correctness.rationale: For a 4-person group, a focal person may change precisely when it is the unique minority. This is exactly odd edge parity (one or three ones). Consequently the full activity vector is Bx over F2 and rank-nullity gives image cardinality 2^r, every fiber and frozen kernel 2^(n-r), orthogonality to ker B^T, full-independence iff row rank m, and consensus-only iff rank n−1 because 1 is in the kernel. For K_n^(4), n≥5, pairwise row differences generate all even-weight vectors, giving rank n−1; the three-edge six-vertex witness has row sum zero and rank two. For s != 4, singleton and triple configurations contradict affine parity. Independent small hypergraph bit-rank and direct-update checks corroborate, but the argument proves arbitrary fixed simple 4-uniform H.
